title: IncuBrix CreatorOps Burnout Cure

copy.headline: Stop paying for scattered tools
copy.support: Replace four fragmented subscriptions with one unified creator studio.

concept: A high-contrast visual metaphor showing four separate leaking subscription boxes merging into one glowing, efficient central creator studio hub, emphasizing the transition from costly fragmentation to seamless unity.

design_system.style: bold flat vector with rich gradients, clean geometric shapes, soft drop shadows and glowing accent highlights
design_system.lighting: top-left studio lighting casting subtle soft glows and sharp edge highlights

composition.hero: A central glowing rounded cube representing the unified studio, surrounded by four smaller fading disconnected app icons in red-tinted containers being pulled inward by glowing cyan and pink energy streams.
props: coins dropping out of broken tool boxes bottom left
glowing connection lines radiating from center
tiny abstract UI wireframes floating around the hub
composition.background: Deep dark navy radial gradient with a large soft violet glow in the center behind the hero
decor: two large faint semi-transparent floating rings in the background
subtle diagonal grid lines across the lower canvas
